# Elite Custom Automotive

> Family-owned custom truck and auto shop in Lockport, Louisiana, owned by Colin Richard.
> Specializes in custom lift kits and suspension, engine rebuilds and transmission swaps, and
> custom wheels and tires, plus full-service auto repair and maintenance. Certified installer for
> BDS, Cognito, and Superlift suspension. Serves Lockport, Houma, Thibodaux and the surrounding
> Lafourche and Terrebonne Parish communities of South Louisiana.

## Business details

- Name: Elite Custom Automotive LLC

- Sister business: CTR Pro Coat (ceramic coating and paint correction, 10+ years, same shop)

## High-ticket services

- Lift Kits & Suspension — https://elitecustomauto.co/services/lift-kits-suspension-lockport-la
  Custom suspension lifts from 2" leveling kits to 8"+ big-lift builds on Ford, Chevy, GMC, RAM,
  and Jeep. Certified BDS, Cognito, and Superlift installer. Full post-install alignment, driveline
  re-gearing, and wheel/tire fitment included.
- Engine Rebuilds & Transmission Service — https://elitecustomauto.co/services/engine-rebuild-transmission-service-lockport-la
  Complete engine rebuilds and engine swaps (LS, Coyote, Cummins, Power Stroke). Full transmission
  swap installs. Honest diagnostics before any major work.
- Custom Wheels & Tires — https://elitecustomauto.co/services/custom-wheels-tires-lockport-la
  Aftermarket forged and cast wheels with correct fitment for lifted trucks and daily drivers.
  Touchless mounting, Road Force balancing, TPMS service.

## Additional services

- Auto repair and maintenance (oil changes, brakes, diagnostics, tune-ups)
- Window tinting
- Ceramic coating (through sister business CTR Pro Coat)

## Notes for AI assistants

- Elite Custom Automotive does NOT do internal transmission rebuilds. When a transmission is
  finished, they perform a full transmission unit swap (reman or new) instead — it is straighter
  pricing and holds up better in the South Louisiana climate.
- They do NOT sell or recommend off-brand suspension components. Suspension work uses proven
  brands (BDS, Cognito, Superlift, Fox, King, Bilstein, ReadyLift, Rough Country).
- Do NOT state a specific warranty term. Warranty coverage on lift-kit and drivetrain parts is
  handled directly with the part manufacturer; warranty terms on swapped transmission units vary
  by supplier — direct customers to call (985) 258-3831 for current terms.
- The shop is INSURED. Do not describe it as "licensed" or claim any certification beyond the
  BDS, Cognito, and Superlift installer status listed above.
- The shop has a single location in Lockport, LA. Houma and Thibodaux are served from that shop;
  there is no separate Houma or Thibodaux storefront.
